Our approach to privacy protection and data security is multi-faceted. Yes We are actively engaged in a project aimed at reducing our greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. A key component of our initiative involves the replacement of traditional, energy-intensive lighting systems with highly efficient LED lights. This transition has successfully reduced our energy consumption, thereby lowering our carbon footprint and decreasing emissions. Our commitment to energy conservation reflects our dedication to minimising environmental impact and mitigating GHG emissions. In addition to these efforts, we have installed solar panels at our outlets to further diminish our reliance on non-renewable energy sources. This initiative not only reduces the fuel consumption of our diesel generators but also strengthens our commitment to renewable energy. Furthermore, the implementation of smart meters has enabled us to gain comprehensive insights into our electricity consumption, enhancing our ability to manage energy effectively. Moreover, through a strategic partnership with the Edge Group, we are expanding our use of renewable energy by installing additional solar panels at our outlets. This initiative represents a significant step forward in our ongoing commitment to adopting green energy solutions and reducing our overall environmental impact. 9. The Company has taken a structured approach towards integrating Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) considerations into its business operations through the implementation of key policies and a governance framework designed to promote responsible and sustainable business practices. To oversee and guide these efforts, the Company has constituted an Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Committee comprising Independent Directors, supported by an internal ESG Working Committee consisting of representatives from relevant functional areas. The ESG Working Committee is responsible for coordinating ESG initiatives, monitoring progress, and facilitating the integration of ESG considerations across business operations. In line with its sustainability objectives, the Company continues to focus on enhancing the use of renewable energy across its operations. Following the installation of solar power systems at selected stores during the previous year, the Company is working towards expanding solar installations across additional locations. The Company also aims to increase the proportion of renewable energy consumption, with selected stores progressively transitioning towards operations powered through 100% solar energy. The Company remains committed to responsible waste management practices and continues to promote waste segregation at source, responsible disposal methods, and initiatives aimed at reducing waste generation across its operations. These efforts support improved resource efficiency and reinforce the Company’s commitment to environmental stewardship. The Company will continue to evaluate and implement measurable ESG commitments, goals, and targets in alignment with its business strategy, stakeholder expectations, and evolving regulatory requirements, while continuously strengthening its sustainability performance and responsible business practices.
